decision.reason: The projection passed isolation, source attribution, historical-snapshot, delete and restore checks. Native Cognee still cannot be used as the context source without fixes: a date in a query returns later facts, update leaves external_metadata at the old revision, summaries need a source_chunk_id join, graph completion needs an LLM key, and dataset scoping depends on access control. A future A/B may use the per-project/per-as_of chunk projection only after these defects are explicitly handled; native graph memory is not ready.
